name: kxcpi
title: Will September 2026 CPI month-over-month increase exceed a given threshold?
settlement: If the Consumer Price Index (CPI) increases by more than the stated threshold (single-decimal) in September 2026, the market resolves Yes. The Expiration Value is the single-decimal month-over-month % change published by the Bureau of Labor Statistics on October 14, 2026, with possible delay if a federal government shutdown disrupts data reliability.
decideContext: Estimate the likely effect of this news on the September 2026 month-over-month CPI percentage change (single-decimal, seasonally adjusted) as published by BLS; the market resolves Yes if that figure exceeds the stated threshold.
